sentences.text: Sebadul Sk. & Ors vs Unknown on 16 January, 2024

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
16.01.2024 Serial no. 06 Anticipatory bail [Rejected] Dd Crm (A) 97 of 2024 In re : An Application
for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with
Raghunathganj Police Station Case No. 593 of 2023 dated 17.07.2023 under Sections 498A/302/34
of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and charge sheet submitted under
Sections 498A/302/304B/34 of the Ipc and  Dowry Prohibition Act. (G.R. Case No. 1753 /2023 )
-And-
In the matter of : Sebadul Sk. & Ors.
... ...Petitioners Ms. Shabana Hasin, Advocate ... ...

For the Petitioners Ms. Rituparna De Ghose,
Advocate ... ...For the State Petitioners before us are the in-laws.

They stand implicated in a police case where the police filed charge sheet, inter alia, under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
Apparently, proclamation process was issued and notices affixed so far as the petitioners are concerned.
Consequently, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is rejected. CRM (A) 97 of 2024 is dismissed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
